purpose: A public bridge-north grain landing that joins the west granary, the third bridge and east-bank cloth production through a continuous working canal.
hero: pile-supported loading deck and open rice barge seen between the third bridge and north granary

circulation.primary: third bridge -> west water street -> bridge-north turning pocket -> descending landing steps -> loading deck
circulation.production: granary gate -> public landing -> rice barge -> east-bank cloth district

structure: continuous northern canal surface overlapping the original water strip
timber loading deck carried by four piles
two grounded mooring posts with visible cross-pins
open boat hull with bottom, ribs, seats, gunwales and stern board
mooring rope with visible boat and post endpoints
